Title: Cheesy Hamburger Potato Casserole (Quotidian Recipes)

Items: 600–700 g potatoes (Yukon Gold or Maris Piper / russet), peeled and thinly sliced
300 g can condensed cream of mushroom soup
Butter or non-stick spray, for greasing
Chopped parsley or sliced spring onions, to garnish (optional)

Instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C. Lightly grease a 23 x 33 cm baking dish (roughly 9 x 13 inch).
In a large frying pan over medium heat, cook the ground beef and diced onion for 6–7 minutes until browned. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Drain excess fat.
In a bowl, whisk together the cream of mushroom soup, milk, Worcestershire sauce, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Layer half the sliced potatoes in the baking dish. Top with half the beef mixture and half the cheddar. Pour over half the soup mixture.
Repeat the layers with the remaining potatoes, beef, cheddar, and soup mixture.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 60–70 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Remove the foil and bake uncovered for 10–15 minutes more, until bubbly and lightly golden on top.
Rest for 10 minutes, then garnish (optional) and serve.
Customizations: Add veg: layer in sliced mushrooms, peppers, peas, or sweetcorn with the beef.
Swap the soup: use cream of chicken soup instead of mushroom.
Add heat: mix 1 tsp chilli flakes or a dash of hot sauce into the soup mixture.
OptionalInstructions: If your potato slices are a bit thicker, add 10–15 minutes to the covered bake time.
For a crispier top, grill for 2–3 minutes at the end (watch closely).
Some recipes use a combination of milk & condensed milk, with the soup.
One recipe uses breadcrumbs, egg & bacon - https://recipessophia.recipesown.com/2025/06/29/loaded-potato-meatloaf-casserole-the-ultimate-one-pan-comfort-dinner/
ServingSuggestions: Serve with a simple green salad or steamed veg.
Garnish with chopped parsley or spring onions for freshness.
